subject: Conformance for object orientation
notes: kb/Work PB1497 landed (wave 1011 C), carrying the override leg of kb/Work PB1112. cite.py --check 9.3.8.2.3 'If the parameter in interface-2 is described with the ACTIVE-CLASS phrase, the corresponding parameter in interface-1 is described with the ACTIVE-CLASS phrase' -> OK 9.3.8.2.3 2) (printed item d)). Arms a)-c) and d) are now pinned over the IMPLEMENTS relation by Rule2ObjectReferenceConformanceTests (20 rows, the conforming ones compile clean). Arm d) was defective two ways: SameDescriptionAs compared the CONTAINING class name, refusing an override whose ACTIVE-CLASS formal is identical (COBOL0829), and an ACTIVE-CLASS formal in an interface method prototype was refused COBOL1924 although a prototype is a method definition (SR16, 10.6.1 NOTE). The description is now owner-less (ObjectRefDescriptor.ActiveClass(null) for a prototype; SameDescriptionAs ignores the containing class); an ACTIVE-CLASS formal crosses the method ABI as the universal object type (OoEmitter.OoFormalCrossingType) so the method, its overrides and the implemented prototype share one C# signature.
